title: Santa Cruz protest/blockade campaign following Camacho’s Dec. 28 arrest
notes: Campaign context only, not one uninterrupted gathering or a new January event. Camacho’s Dec. 28 arrest is the documented campaign trigger, not a verified date for the first physical assembly/blockade. Contemporary reporting documents blockades/vigils in early January, a Jan. 18 decision to open main routes, and a Jan. 25 national cabildo. El Deber's Jan. 18 road report marks a local phase change; CIVICUS/UCB are retrospective secondary sources. The physical episode onset and overall campaign end are unknown.

start_date.summary: No opened source explicitly dates the first physical gathering/blockade to Dec. 28. The first physical action date is unknown.

cross_month_activity.summary: El Deber reports blockades/vigils on Jan. 3 and Jan. 4 and main routes open on Jan. 18; Correo del Sur recounts Jan. 2 march/vigil actions.

end_date.summary: The Jan. 18 route opening marks a local blockade phase, not the end of the campaign; the Feb. 16 retrospective calls it declining/latent but gives no end date.

campaign_trigger_date.summary: These contemporary/retrospective accounts identify Camacho’s Dec. 28 arrest as the campaign trigger; this is context, not an event start date.
